---
description: Start supervised story delivery with the swarm orchestrator
---
Use this prompt with the swarm-orchestrator selected in VS Code Copilot. Read `swarm/templates/start-story.md`, `swarm/PROJECT.md` and `swarm/WORKFLOW.md`. Work in shadow mode. Accept the human-provided story snapshot with ADO ID and revision. Delegate planning and stop for approval before code changes. Use exact approved local build/test commands only, and stop after each increment with a review packet. No automatic push, ticket update or deployment.
